crumb "PART" "RANDOM"
panel RND -
param RANDOM.OSC "OSC" choice lin 0 3 1 2 -
opt RANDOM.OSC 0 "OFF"
opt RANDOM.OSC 1 "PURE"
opt RANDOM.OSC 2 "RICH"
opt RANDOM.OSC 3 "WILD"
param RANDOM.ENV "ENV" choice lin 0 3 1 3 -
opt RANDOM.ENV 0 "OFF"
opt RANDOM.ENV 1 "PLUCK"
opt RANDOM.ENV 2 "PAD"
opt RANDOM.ENV 3 "ANY"
param RANDOM.TONE "TONE" choice lin 0 3 1 2 -
opt RANDOM.TONE 0 "OFF"
opt RANDOM.TONE 1 "SOFT"
opt RANDOM.TONE 2 "BRIGHT"
opt RANDOM.TONE 3 "WILD"
param RANDOM.MOD "MOD" choice lin 0 3 1 1 -
opt RANDOM.MOD 0 "OFF"
opt RANDOM.MOD 1 "SUBTLE"
opt RANDOM.MOD 2 "MOVING"
opt RANDOM.MOD 3 "WILD"
param RANDOM.SEED "SEED" stepped lin 0 255 1 0 -
OK
